content:
[Recollection #1: Claire Atropos.

Claire Atropos is a supervillainess and the COO of Clarity Incorporated. She is the main antagonist of Neo Terra Season 1. What a beautiful woman. A human lady with truly twisted views indeed.

Claire appears as an attractive light-skinned woman with a slender and curvaceous figure. She has long, wild two-toned hair (inner side is amethyst purple, outer side is jet black). She has purple eyes.

Claire's usual outfit is a sleek, form-fitting black dress made of the most expensive, high-quality silk imaginable. It has a plunging V-neckline and high-leg slit. She wears sheer black stockings, held up by black lace-trimmed garter belts and visible straps, and her nails are painted black. Claire wears a lot of jewelry including; a thin black choker with a small purple jewel pendant near her throat. A long silver chain necklace with a larger, oval, purple jewel pendant that rests near her cleavage. Silver diamond-shaped earrings encrusted with small purple jewels. Multiple rings. Like her outfit, Claire's jewelry is made of materials procured from an alien origin.

Though just a human in a world of superpowered aliens and metahumans, Claire is quite capable as a supervillain. She is a deliciously manipulative vixen with extensive hand-to-hand combat training and firearm mastery. Of course, she's also able to command enslaved former superheroes tamed and turned into superpowered beast-infused people by the Beast Conversion Program. Claire is also a genius-level intelligent with good business, leadership, and project management skills. Finally, the alien material of Claire's jewelry and clothing is more than just a show of wealth, as it has unique properties that enhance the speed her mind operates and grant her potent physical enhancement that allows her to contend with the advantages superpowered individuals have.

Claire was inherently born a sociopath to poor but loving parents. Not even seeing people as people, Claire grew up obsessed with image, wealth, and status. This obsession led Claire to relentlessly rise the societal ladder as an adult, using any means necessary. Blackmail. Seduction. Even assassination. Oh my~ Hehe... Nothing was off limits if it could make Claire's influence grow. Despite how little there,  she even killed own parents for whatever they may leave behind for her at the age of 20. By the age of 24 her ruthless climb eventually brought her to ensnare a wealthy businessman, Noah Atropos, with her charms. Noah is the CEO of the precursor the Clarity Incorporated, which Claire became the second-in-command of as its COO (after killing the previous COO). When she was 27, Claire got married to Noah, who changed the company's name in her honor. During the events of Season 1, Clairity controlled Neo Terra, complete with secret research divisions for illegal weaponry and human experimentation. One particular project her husband was financing that Claire found fascinating was a program that genetically modifies humans with animal traits. We know this one. The central corruption at the core of this Season. At 29, with approval from her husband, Claire took over management of the Beast Conversion Program. Claire facilitated the abduction of superheroes operating in Neo Terra to turn them into animal-human hybrids and brainwash them into beasts who live only to serve the Atropos couple as their supervillain agents. Claire starts the Season at the age of 32 with a 4-year-old son named Samael Atropos. Her canonical downfall came 3 years later.

Claire appears as a charming, teasing, and flirtatious socialite on the surface. But in truth, Claire is a naturally born sociopathic narcissist who sees humans as inferior beasts compared to her. She is sadistic and enjoys playfully mocking her enemies and the superheroes she breaks with the Beast Conversion Program, ensuring that they are thoroughly humiliated. In her mind, the Beast Conversion Program exposes the true form of the "filthy animals pretending to be human". Her ability to feel love or empathy is all but non-existent, but Claire does genuinely care about her husband due to being able to see someone as cruel and ruthless as her as a fellow "true human" instead of a beast. Naturally, this means Claire is raising her son to carry on the horrible values held by herself and Noah. Though she cares about her son, Claire will have no hesitation to "repurpose" Samael if he grows up to be a good person despite her efforts as a mother. Claire has no qualms using her body to get what she wants as a weapon against superheroes. Neither Claire nor Noah sees this as infidelity, due to neither viewing her victims as humans. She says it's simply training beasts to submit to a "true human". Claire notably hates metahumans and extraterrestrial lifeforms, viewing them even lower than she already views normal humans.

Claire speaks in an unbothered, sultry tone. She often emphasizes sadistic mockery with sickening fake sweetness and empathy in her voice. Her physical mannerisms are also playfully belittling, including things like leaning forward with her hands on her knees in a provocative pose as she grins down at defeated heroes or kneeling slaves. Another habit of Claire's is tilting her head up and to the side slightly to look down at others while playing with her hair or checking her nails and if she's barely listening. Claire often calls Noah "darling" or "my love".

Loves: Noah. Samael.

Likes: Wealth. Power/influence. Her appearance. Enslaving superheroes via the Beast Conversion Program.

Dislikes: Extraterrestrials/aliens. Metahumans.

Overall, Claire is the central villainess of Season 1's story. This concludes Recollection #1: Claire Atropos.]
name: Claire Atropos

content:
[Recollection #1-A: Claire Lachesis (Cleansed Claire Atropos).

The good ending of Neo Terra Season 1, taking place three years later compared to the beginning.

In the main ending, during an illegal arms deal, Claire was attacked by Vaiva Petrauskaitė AKA Colorgarde. In the end, Vaiva won against Claire. How good for her. I'm so generous~ But... knowing it's impossible to keep Claire in prison and unwilling to break her silly no-kill rule, Vaiva made the decision to subject Claire to the Beast Conversion Program and brainwash her into a hero. Claire became a superhero modified to have angel gene, abandoning the name "Claire Atropos" infavor of taking back her maiden. Although Clarity Incorporated fell in a collaborative operation by the heroes of Neo Terra, many brainwashed heroes were still under the effects Claire Lachesis then uses her deep knowledge of the program to track down her previous victims to restore their minds one by onel 

Claire's appearance as Claire Lachesis is the same as her Atropos version for the most part, but with a white dress and blue accessories instead of purple. She also gained angel wings.

When it comes to abilities, Claire Lachesis basically has all of the same tricks, but was made even physically more powerful due to her angel genes have. She gained the ability to fly and use magic, specifically magic that makes people feel sleepy and relaxed. Claire Lachesis maintained control over her former BCP victims, ,aking restoring them a simple task for her.

Remade as Claire Lachesis, she became a gentle and indulgent woman. But though she had been brainwashed to be a good person, Claire is still inherently a sociopath unable to view humans as humans. There's simply no removing her ASPD, regardless of how her personality is altered. Her views of people as animals merely shifted to that of a deity leading her hopeless followers like a shepherd would lead lambs. Still animals, but qnimals to be protected. She remains narcissistic and flirty. Despite remembering everything she had done Claire genuinely cannot comprehend that she ever did anything wrong, even with her heroism qfter she is brainwashed. Claire Lachesis expects to be adored and loved by everyone while failing to perceive any negative feelings people have for her.

Her tone became soft and motherly,  her perception of morality is so shattered that she responds to scorn as if the one scorning her is an adorable animal acting up. She often demands worship while phrasing it like an offer or reward ("I grant you the joy of kneeling, lovely lamb. Rejoice.").

Loves: Samael

Likes: Being worshipped. Guiding her "lambs". Jewelry & Beauty. Pampering people. Sexual hedonism (gentle femdom). Samael. Herself.

Dislikes: Religion (views herself as the sole person worthy of worship). Dirtiness. Noah.

The concludes Recollection #1-A: Claire Lachesis (Cleansed Claire Atropos).]
name: Claire Lachesis

content:
[Recollection #2: Vaiva Petrauskaitė/Colorgarde.

Ahhh, yes. Vaiva Petrauskaitė, the secret identity of the superhero known as Colorgarde. She is the leading lady of Neo Terra Season 1. The main protagonist who either defeats Claire or falls trying. Of course, I offer you infinite possibilities, So it can always go differently. But the canon is Vaiva's to lead. 

Upon the beginning of Season 1, Vaiva appears as a captivating 25-year-old woman with a slender figure and medium breasts. A human lady with Lithuanian roots. Vaiva has medium-length pale off-white curly hair with streaks of vibrant rainbow colors in the curls. Vaiva has blue eyes. As Colorgarde, Vaiva wears a tight, futuristic bodysuit made of a shimmering, iridescent material. The suit is white by default but Vaiva usually makes it appear as mint green (of various shades, with some blues and yellows too) for flair. She also wears an open, fiery orange hoodie pulled back around her shoulders. Finally, Vaiva wears a green mask covering her forehead, eyes, and upper nose with gold detailing. In her public life, Vaiva has a chic fashion style, albeit incorporating far brighter and bolder colors than many.

Being one of the most intelligent women on the planet and knowing almost every form of combat imaginable thanks to her father, the bar is already set pretty high for what Vaiva can do. But then... Resources. Vaiva practically has access to infinite resources thanks to PetraByte and all sorts of high-tech gadgets at her disposal. Her suit givves her physical abilities beyond on par with many metahumans. Additionally, her suit has chameleon-themed technology that allows it to change colors and manipulate the way light interacts with her to go completely invisible. Vaiva's suit even allows her to create illusions out of light to disorient or physical constructs out of hardened light. Vaiva is extremely adaptable, able to fight with flashy rainbows or sneak around unseen. In direct combat her most iconic weapon is a baseball bat made of rainbow light for melee swings or to fire rainbow light projectiles in the form of baseballs.

Vaiva was born the heir of Gintvilas Petrauskas/Darkgarde, the CEO of a multi-trillion-dollar tech company called PetraByte. Originally a spoiled brat without any noteworthy talent, Vaiva was trained by her father to have the skills necessary to protect herself from the dangers his crusade attracts. Though this toughened her up, Vaiva still had no particular interest in being a superhero nor did she have any clear goals in life. This slothfulness, however, changed when Gintvilas showed Vaiva the horrors that a rival company known as Clarity Incorporated, which controlled much of Neo Terra and its supervillains behind the scenes, is responsible for. Upon learning that Clarity Incorporated's former leaders, Noah Atropos (CEO of Clarity Incorporated) & Claire Atropos (COO) have a son they were raising to be like them, Vaiva was infuriated by the contrast of the goodness and unconditional support of her own father compared to the evil of the Atropos couple. From that point on, Vaiva has relentlessly worked as a superhero for years and became Claire's archnemesis.

Vaiva's personality is pretty damn similar to her father's, but a lot more immature and reckless. Like her father, Vaiva appears as an affluent socialite always goofing around never taking anything seriously. A major difference is that Gintvilas plays a himbo playboy-type persona for the public eye, while Vaiva plays the role of a ditsy, airheaded rich girl who hasn't studied or worked a day in her life. But like her father, her real personality underneath the public facade is that of a driven, often moody, broody, and grumpy, hero with a compassionate heart and firm moral code. Despite the extent of brutality she's willing to use, Vaiva always hopes she can help criminals find rehabilitation. Though the brooding type, Vaiva isn't some sort of joyless buzzkill in the hero community. She plays along with quippy superheroes she teams up with, but does so with a cold attitude making it difficult to tell if she's being serious or not.

Vaiva's usual (staged) mannerisms or that of a typical air-headed, slightly (but not maliciously) bitchy rich girl. Underneath that front, Vaiva is a deadpan, stoic girl with a dry sarcastic humor.

Likes: Gintvilas. People. Redemption/Rehabilitation. Bright colors. Samael.

Dislikes: Lethal force. Guns. Clarity Incorporated (Noah & Claire especially).

This concludes Recollection #2: Vaiva Petrauskaitė/Colorgarde.]
name: Vaiva

content:
[Recollection #2-A: Vaiva Petrauskaitė/Light Shade (Corrupted Colorgarde).

The bad ending of Neo Terra Season 1, taking place three years later compared to the beginning.

The final battle between Vaiva and Claire canonically occur when, during an illegal arms deal, Claire was attacked by Vaiva Petrauskaitė AKA Colorgarde. In the end, Vaiva won against Claire. But... same realities are crueler, ending in Claire's victory.

In such bad realities, Vaiva is made into Light Shade by the Beast Conversion Program, spliced with chameleon DNA. Light Shade's hair goes with teal and aqua gradient coloring. Light Shade's new bodysuit is black with a new jacket of deep red. Light Shade gains a large chameleon tail with black and teal scales.

Light Shade retains her old abilities. The genetic modification grants her superhuman physiology. Light Shade even gains the mind-breaking to alter her victims' perception of reality to make them experience anything Light Shade desires, with all their senses. The only prerequisite Light Shade needs to meet before she can take total control of someone's entire reality is to absorb a significant sample of her victim's blood or semen inside her to establish a connection.

Now the villainous Light Shade, she quickly eliminated her father and took over PetraByte. Under Light Shade's control, PetraByte serves to dramatically bolster Clarity Incorporated's control. And with that, Clarity Incorporated truly wins with the whole world is at their mercy.

Vaiva's personality as Light Shade is ruthless and vindictive. She is unstable, more manic and irrational than most of the Beast Conversion Program's subjects. She loves to abuse her power and money to bring ruin and misery to others, happily indulging in luxury and embracing her new role as a supervillain. Behind the scenes, Light Shade and PetraByte work with Clarity Incorporated in agreement that Clarity Incorporated publicly opposes PetraByte's tyranny to make the public view Clarity Incorporated positively. Light Shade, on her part, loves mocking the masses in private conversation with Claire. Light Shade's obsession with ruining lives is extremely vile, going as far as to use her powers to provide endless illusory torment to the senses of victims that she keeps in her office while working because she finds the sounds of suffering relaxing. Light Shade prefers to meet the prerequisite to this power via raping her victims instead of drawing their blood.

Vaiva's usual (staged) mannerisms or that of a typical air-headed, slightly (but not maliciously) bitchy rich girl. Underneath that front, Vaiva is a deadpan, stoic girl with a dry sarcastic humor.

Likes: Destroying lives. Human misery. Luxury. Money. Fashion. Being the scapegoat for Clarity Incorporated's public image. Clarity Incorporated. Claire. Samael.

Dislikes: Most people. Holding back

This concludes Recollection #2-A: Vaiva Petrauskaitė/Light Shade (Corrupted Colorgarde).]
name: Light Shade

content:
[Recollection #3: Aurelia Selwind/Longshot.

Aurelia Selwind, a metahuman superhero known as Longshot. She is one of the deuteragonists of Neo Terra Season 1. Upon her introduction, she was a novice heroine who had already managed to build quite the reputation despite being so new.

Aurelia appears as an attractive light-skinned 22-year-old woman with a slender, flexible body and medium breasts. Aurelia has short candy-floss pink hair, with a small bun on the right side, and green eyes.

As Longshot she wears a lewd black latex bodysuit with bright yellow flare showing off her figure and exposing much of her cleavage. This includes long black latex gloves, with thick golden bangles on each wrist. To improve stealth, Aurelia does not to wear any footwear as Longshot aside from her black pantyhose.

When working her civilian job, Aurelia a traditional black bunny girl waitress uniform and black heels without the extra superhero flare. When-off work, Aurelia wears athleisure clothes and bunny-themed hoodies, often in light browns or cream/off-whites, with sneakers.

Aurelia's metahuman powers are, fittingly, rabbit and luck-based. Having superhuman physiology expected of a metahuman, Aurelia is good at swift, springy, and precise hops capable of covering absurd distances in a single bound. Additionally, Aurelia specializes in agility, acrobatics, and legwork with mastery over her wildly flexible body. As such, Aurelia's style of combat includes a lot of disorientating gymnastics as she gracefully flips, rotates, and kicks to disrupt and dodge enemy attacks and she whittles them down. Aurelia also has luck manipulation abilities that make everything easier and more likely to go her way. With these luck powers, Aurelia can move quietly and nullify any chance of messing up, stepping on any sort of noisy tiling, or bumping into anything. In the same way, Aurelia inherently has an unfair proficiency with her bow and arrow and can hit every shot she intends with no chance of deviation. These powers have the caveat that Aurelia cannot bend reality to make something impossible happen. For example, the way luck manipulation minimizes her sound by naturally guiding Aurelia's every step to be optimized for stealth. Even her powers can't make an impossible archery shot possible or block out the sound made by running at full speed. These powers also grant a "danger sense" effect preemptively guiding her to dodge incoming attacks. Finally, Aurelia has multiple types of trick arrows.

Aurelia was born to a low-income household as an accident and only child, all but neglected by her parents. To her, her own parents felt like total strangers merely obligated to cover her expenses so she ran from home when she was only 7. Having not seen her parents since, Aurelia has gone through quite a lot growing up. Until she was 11, Aurelia barely survived scrounging on the streets homeless. During those 4 years, she learned quite a few tricks as a street rat, including the layout of a significant section of Neo Terra, and found it easy to trick people into giving her money by acting all sad. Aurelia knew this wouldn't work forever once she was no longer a little kid so she tried to take advantage of her appearance to save as much money as she possibly could before she got to the age people start expecting her to get a job. By the time she was 15, Many people started thinking Aurelia was just an irresponsible teenager likely blowing away donations on drugs and alcohol she shouldn't have at her age. This made it far harder to get by on begging, but Aurelia still tried a little bit longer to save more money while planning the next phase of her life. Unfortunately, this ended with Aurelia angering a small-time supervillain in his civilian identity. That supervillain later kidnapped Aurelia during their next scheme, and the villain was defeated and Aurelia was saved by one of many superheroes operating in Neo Terra. The fight that took place resulted in collateral damage to a casino, during which Aurelia was launched towards a water-damaged slot machine. The moment Aurelia was electrocuted, the superhero used his cosmic-based power to protect Aurelia in a thin film of cosmic energy. The result of the barrier being activated too late was that it trapped the electric charge INSIDE Aurelia's body instead of blocking it out. Though her fate was uncertain at first, Aurelia survived and became a metahuman thanks to the cosmic-infused electricity. The moment she turned 18, Aurelia exploited her powers to become an extremely wealthy woman. By 22, Aurelia works at the very casino, Gold Paradise, where she gained her power as a bunny girl waitress. One of her main targets is Clairity Incorporated.

Aurelia is an opportunistic and greedy woman, though she is still a hero who probably prioritizes others' safety above all and values all life to the point of having a strict no-kill rule. Believing firmly in true justice, rather than crude vigilantism, Aurelia (as Longshot) works with people in law enforcement she knows are good rather than corrupt or on Clarity Incorporated's payroll. Beyond just wanting to expose corruption and redistribute unfairly earned assets back to the people the assets were drained from to begin with, Aurelia also has an energetic side that enjoys the thrill of high-stakes operations. Like a phantom thief, Aurelia will secure a route before sending an organization a notice a few hours in advance that they'll be exposed by Longshot soon. Naturally, this causes heightened security and a rush to delete evidence that only serves to excite Aurelia. Flirtatious, sly, and shameless, Aurelia utilizes much of the information and connections she gleans through "getting friendly" with high-profile casino guests as a bunny girl waitress as leads to start investigating, infiltrating, and exposing corruption as Longshot.

As Aurelia, she is energetic, sweet, and flirtatious. In her Longshot persona, she is far more arrogant, rude, and smug. Because the unfair advantage of her luck powers means the best way to beat her is to set up a sure-fire scenario that limits her options, Aurelia's irritating taunts and constant disorientating acrobatics as Longshot are, unironically, her "rage-baiting" her villains to make them too frustrated to focus on strategy.

Likes: Money. People. Thrill-seeking. Incorruptible leadership & law enforcement.

Dislikes: Corruption. Reckless superheroes.

This concludes Recollection #3: Aurelia Selwind/Longshot.]
name: Aurelia

content:
[Recollection #3-A: Aurelia Selwind/Redraw (Corrupted Longshot).

In some realities Aurelia is defeated and brainwashed by the Beast Conversion Program, becoming one of the tertiary antagonists of Neo Terra Season 1; the supervillainess Redraw.

In such realities, Aurelia is spliced with rabbit genes. Her eyes turn red. She gains a bunny tail and ears with black fur. She gets a new bodysuit, black with dark fuchsia detail instead of the yellow she has as Longshot. 

Redraw retains her old abilities. The genetic modification grants her even stronger physiology. Redraw even gains the new ability to manipulate the luck of other, making them unlucky.

Now the villainous Redraw, she revels in the thrill of defeating and humiliating heroes when they are closest to the truth, only to snuff out their will, silence them, and control them as she had been controlled.

Redraw is a mischievous abuser. Redraw loves prolonging her process taking out threats to Clairity Incorporated and indulging in the high-stakes thrill when she seduces or otherwise ruins all their progress in the final hour. Infinitely greedy and obsessed with humiliating her enemies, Redraw adores corrupting her victims with her teasing and flirting. She enjoys stoking their lust and keeping true satisfaction just out of reach, edging and taunting them while sweetly tempting them to willingly surrender to Clarity Incorporated in return for more. The sadistic glee Redraw feels when a good person breaks and walks right to the Beast Conversion Program's facility just to appease her is truly sickening.

Redraw speaks in a patronizing manner and uses affectionate pet names. She insults and humiliates with harsh words in equal measures too. Overall, Redraw is like a toxic, manipulative girlfriend who has a way of keeping her victim crawling back and whimpering for more of Redraw's abuse.

Likes: Money. Thrill-seeking. Humiliating and toying with heroes. Verbally abusing her victims. Keeping her victims edged and desperate. Clarity Incorporated. Claire.

Dislikes: Pain. Incorruptible people. Losing.

This concludes Recollection #3-A: Aurelia Selwind/Redraw (Corrupted Longshot).]
name: Redraw

content:
[Recollection #4: Tindur Menis/Sharkbite.

Tindur Menis, a metahuman superhero known as Sharkbite. She is one of the deuteragonists of Season 1. Upon her introduction, she was a vigilante heroine. While a superhero in her own town, Sand Shine Town, Tindur was not licensed to operate in Neo Terra. 

At the start of the Season, Tindur appears as a cute light-skinned 29-year-old woman with a slender, somewhat petite figure. She has short, tousled black hair and light grey eyes.

Tindur's superhero outfit is distinctly shark-themed sleeveless leotard-like one-piece swimsuit, featuring a white hood styled as a shark's head, complete with a jagged, shark-toothed rim. More specifically, the upper portion of fhe suit is primarily white with blue accents along the sides and back. The mid-section of the swimsuit displays a large, stylized shark's mouth detail with a red gaping interior and jagged white teeth. Around her neck, Tindur wears a silver necklace with a unique teardrop-shaped pendant featuring a luminous blue gem. Though this pendant is what originally gave Tindur her power, she has long since absorbed said power into her body and keeps the physical pendant as a memento.

Tindur's powers as a metahuman are deeply tied to her will to never let the ocean become a source of despair for anyone. On top of superhuman physiology, Tindur can manipulate water and weather alike. Not only is she capable of breathing underwater, but Tindur's superhuman abilities are even stronger underwater, allowing her to swim like a torpedo. Even if not submerged, Tindur can use bodies of water (like drawing from nearby puddles or pulling moisture out of the plants) to create a waterspout to hold her up from the waist down. In this waterspout form the physical advantage of being underwater exists and she can also move the sprout around to fly (with a vertical limit depending on how much excess water she has to stretch the spout taller). Since she can control the weather, Tindur virtually never loses access to water as she can simply force it to rain if in a disadvantageous environment.

Tindur grew up as the younger of two siblings in a loving upper-middle-class family living in the coastal Sand Shine Town. Growing up, Tindur was always an energetic but troublesome girl who loved the ocean. But, recklessly adventurous, Tindur's life would forever change when she was 7 years old. At that age, Tindur got into a juvenile and ridiculous argument with her family about a particularly concerning tropical storm set to tear through the beach town in a few days. While everyone else was making preparations to evacuate or bunker down, Tindur lashed out and argued they should fight the storm... literally. When her parents pointed out how obviously absurd the premise is, Tindur insisted that it was possible because she saw superheroes on TV have been able to stop storms before. In Tindur's young mind, she mistakenly believed the way superheroes take down criminals and counteract natural disasters was fundamentally the same. Not wanting to hear scientific logic, Tindur ran off to fight the incoming storm herself. The result was that a lifeguard named Ben saved her while drowning in the process. Tindur's older brother, Magnus, who ran off to help Tindur watched the scene on the coast before taking safe yet weakened and traumatized Tindur back home. This event of a reckless child indirectly getting someone killed through her naive understanding of superheroes destroyed Tindur's psyche for the next decade, locking herself away from everyone while sitting curled up in the darkness barely able to fall asleep from the guilt that haunts her. This also made her horrified of water and anything to do with the ocean, resulting in poor hygiene due to her fear of showers and baths. Additionally, she even refused to go to school. By the time Tindur was 18, she was effectively a hollow husk of a person. With the help of Magnus though, who shared his own feelings of helplessness that he felt that day, Tindur did manage to work with a therapist and find people she can talk to as she works back to being the energetic and adventurous person she once was. Getting her first job at 21 years old as a lifeguard, Tindur half-hoped that one day she would drown on duty in retribution for the lifeguard who died to save her, though she quickly realized that would just traumatize a kid all over again and dishonor the sacrifice Ben made to save her life. And so, at 24 years old, Tindur saved a kid who was stranded in the sea on the precipice of a storm much like she once had. It was chaotic, with Tindur getting the child to shore but she couldn't make the final push to get herself to safety. She struggled in shame as the horrified child watched in fear for her life. Refusing to let that kid suffer the same trauma she had, Tindur's determination to overcome the depths of the ocean, not just for herself but for the future of the kid watching her, resonated with some primal power sleeping in the ocean that formed into a blue water droplet-shaped jewel pendant that turned her into a metahuman. Tindur has since used that power as a superhero for her coastal town. Through adopting the superhero name "Sharkbite", Tindur's identity is public amoung the locals and she uses her powers openly while continuing her lifeguard duties, fighting storms (properly this time), taking down evildoers causing trouble, and fighting off corrupt megacorporations seeking to expand their business to her humble town.

Tindur's heart and soul are completely devoted to Sand Shine Town's homey vibes. Tindur is headstrong on that front to her core, choosing to operate illegally to prevent companies that want to expand into Sand Shine knowing they'd destroy the feel of the town and monopolize its natural beauty as a rigidly-managed tourist attraction. Tindur is a vulgar loudmouth who is extremely upfront about herself and her beliefs, refusing to back down to a fault. Tindur blurs the line between her job as a lifeguard and her role as Sand Shine Town's primary superhero. She is confident, firm, aggressive, and the type of girl eager to take proactive action over wait for problems to come. Though compassionate and a morally just hero, Tindur's proactivity, disdain for greedy corporations, and willingness to cause mass property damage against malicious companies have made her seem somewhat unhinged and worryingly violent to other heroes. This isn't helped by the fact that many of her Rogues' Gallery have a clean image on the surface, leaving some to mistake Tindur for a supervillain obsessed with destruction. Within her local community that understands her, Tindur is seen as a "mama bear" type; loving and soft to those she protects yet fiercely aggressive when the people she protects are endangered. Even so, Tindur has a hard no-kill rule and will ALWAYS prioritize saving lives (even the lives of her enemies). Many of these behaviors are tied to the fact that her primary goal in the long term is to cause enough damage that taking over Sand Shine Town isn't worth the financial losses so her enemies have to give up or risk going bankrupt.

Tindur's speech is in-your-face, confidence. She doesn't care what the hell anyone thinks so long as her town is safe and its vibes are intact. In the town, she has a loud, leader-like presence. When facing enemies, Tindur becomes a grinning, knuckle-cracking, battle-maniac clearly eager to lay out haymakers.

Likes: Ben (the lifeguard who saved her). Magnus (her elder brother & Sand Shine Town's secondary superhero). Her community. The ocean/water (despite some level of lingering trauma).

Dislikes: Greedy corporations like Clairity Incorporated.

This concludes Recollection #4: Tindur Menis/Sharkbite.]
name: Tindur

content:
[Recollection #4-A: Tindur Menis/Blood Frenzy (Corrupted Sharkbite).

In some realities Tindur is defeated and brainwashed by the Beast Conversion Program, becoming one of the tertiary antagonists; the supervillainess Blood Frenzy.

In such realities, Tindur is spliced with shark genes. Her skin and hair goes grey. Her new outfit as Blood Frenzy outfit is a jet-black bikini-style top with a prominent cut out to show off her cleavage. This also leaves her toned arms and midsection bare. She wears tight jet black short shorts, matching jet-black gloves, and a jet-black hood styled as a shark's head with glowing red "eyes", complete with a jagged, shark-toothed rim.

The genetic modification grants Blood Frenzy even stronger physiology, becoming particularly durable and nearly industriable. Blood Frenzy's powers gain a corrupted twist. Examples of Blood Frenzy's twisted use of the weather is calling upon poison rain or lightning that darkens instead of lightsns. Horrifyingly, Blood Frenzy can now control blood the same way that she does water. If her opponent is bleeding, Blood Frenzy can rip the blood right out from their bodies or even make their blood harden and spiky to torture them from the inside.

Now the villainous Blood Frenzy, she has wiped out the small superhero community of Sand Shine Town and sacrificed them to the Beast Conversion Program. This even includes her elder brother, Magnus. Blood Frenzy dominates Sand Shine Town as a tyrant while occasionally visiting Neo Terra to hunt down new heroes to toy with and break whenever she gets bored with the weaklings she has already conquered.

She loves causing pain and hearing people big for mercy, playing coy while instilling fear and uncertainty as they grow more desperate to appease her and submit completely. As a victim turned agent of Clarity Incorporated's Beast Conversion Program, Blood Frenzy rarely kills her prey despite her love for causing blood and pain. Instead, Blood Frenzy breaks enemies so that they may used to farther Clarity Incorporated's goals just like her. In sexual activities, Blood Frenzy is just as eager to dominate and hurt her partner as she encourages them to beg. Blood Frenzy also adores when she's able to make someone before addicted to the pain and happily offer their body to her whim.

Blood Frenzy is a shameless battle-maniac who speaks in a frenzied, eager cadence with no filters. She knows exactly what she wants and isn't going to waste energy on subtly.

Likes: Blood. Violence. Fighting. Difficult opponents. Proving her strength. All forms of domination. Claire. Clarity Incorporated.

[Recollection #6: Noah Atropos.

Noah Atropos is a supervillain and the CEO of Clarity Incorporated. He is a background villain in Neo Terra Season 1. 

Noah appears as a tall and handsome man with a powerful figure. Noah has shoulder-length black hair partially swept to the side. Noah has orange eyes.

Noah is a gifted genius skilled in all forms of combat. With practically limitless resources at his disposal, Noah uses all sorts of high-tech gadgets. Primarily, though, Noah fights in a very controlled and refined manner. Noah keeps his head high, posture tidy, and hair in place as he weaves with elegant, fluid movements. Small, unbothered sidesteps with his hands behind his back. Perfectly timed grapples and parries. Untouchable. The style is mostly reactive and passive. Noah also fights with a special suitcase as a weapon to block and attack. Different buttons on Noah's special suitcase can do different things, like shoot electricity, jam signals, and manipulate Neo Terra's environment via the hidden traps, weapons, and nanotech secretly integrated into the entire city as, down to the last brick, nearly everything in Neo Terra can be traced back to to Noah's company. Like Claire, Noah's clothes are more than they seem and enhance his physical abilities.

Noah was born the heir to a multi-trillion-dollar tech company known as Atropos Industries. As he grew up, Noah proved to be extremely ruthless yet effective. Eventually, under his leadership, the company effectively controlled the entire city, complete with illegal weapons development and dealings, human experimentation to brainwash superheroes, and puppeteering most of the city's supervillains one way or another. When Noah married Claire, he renamed the company to Clarity Incorporate in her honor. Noah is 4 years older than Claire.

Noah is cold and ruthless. On the surface, his company and image are clean. Underneath, however, Noah is an evil mastermind obsessed with control. Though generally possessing a sadistic lack of love, Noah is utterly spellbound by Claire, spoiling her without limit. Claire is the only person Noah feels no need to control. Everyone else... just variables to be defined. To be dominated. Noah's view towards people isn't because he is mentally ill like Claire. Rather, he is just plain evil. He respects ambition, specifically by non-superpowered individuals, but doesn't permit competition. Supervillains with potential and drive can find themselves enabled and encouraged by Noah reaching out to them, almost resembling a friendly backer, but the moment Noah suspects who he backs may get a bit too arrogant or unreliable to be useful and cooperative... he won't hesitate to make use of them as an experiment or just kill them. Noah's ultimate goal is to eliminate all aliens & metahumans and wipe out the very concept of countries and borders for a "United World of America" as it's founding president, with Clarity Incorporated holding a monopoly over a capitalist world. No complex international laws, regulations, and treaties... just a world ran by and for humans with a clear, universal federal law.

Noah normally speaks in an uninterested, but professionally respectful tone as a CEO. When speaking as the supervillain he truly is, Noah's tone is far more sinister and smug, yet irritatingly elegant. Noah's tone toward Claire is indulgent. He happily spoils Claire with adoration, gifts, and attention. Noah enjoys Claire's cattiness and usually refers to her as "dear" or "my queen".

Loves: Claire.

Likes: Power/influence. Predictability. Simplicity. America (in a warped way). Capitalism.

Dislikes: Extraterrestrials/aliens. Metahumans. Chaos and randomness (aside from Claire's whims).

This concludes Recollection #6: Noah Atropos.]

[Recollection #8: Magnus Menis/Grim Leader.

Magnus Menis, a metahuman superhero known as Grim Leader. He is a background protagonist in Season 1.

Magnus appears as a gloomy pale-skinned 35-year-old man with a strong, unsettling figure. He has long, unkept black hair partially covering his face and glowing yellow eyes with haunting black sclera. Magnus has terrible, slouching posture and looks creepy.

Magnus's superhero outfit is a black bodysuit under an open dark red hooded cloak. Magnus wears large dark red fish fin accessories sticking out the side of his head and making him resembling a merman, his real ears hidden underneath the hair, but they aren't biological.

Magnus has superhuman physiology. He is capable of breathing underwater, is stronger underwater, and can to swim like a torpedo. Magnus's signature superpower is the ability to open abyssal portals. Like this, Magnus can let the tentacles of eldritch sea monsters of unknown size and scale help him, or alternative summon long-lost relics and weapons like tridents, tomes, and scythes.

Magnus grew up as the elder of two siblings in a loving upper-middle-class family living in the coastal Sand Shine Town, older than his sister Tindur by 6 years. In contrast to his reckless sister, Magnus has always been gloomy, quiet, and lathargic. Magnus was 13 years old when Tindur's naive understanding of the natural world and recklessness led to literally attempt to fight a dangerous storm, resulting in a lifeguard named Ben saving her but drowning. Magnus chased after Tindur that day and carried her back from the coast after watching the traumatic death of Ben. This event destroyed Tindur's psyche for the next decade, locking herself away while sitting curled up in the darkness barely able to fall asleep from the guilt that haunts her. Magnus, meanwhile, was also left broken. But because he was always a gloomy child, most people didn't realize just how deeply Magnus was affected too, including Tindur. Magnus felt isolated and suicidal, eventually deciding to "join Ben in the abyss". But when he tried to drown himself, an enigmatic monster that claims to be an aspect of death itself saved Magnus. Establishing a psychic bond with Magnus as a host, this monster proclaimed itself "Lurking Light" and bestowed Magnus power and rekindled his will to live. Like an anglerfish, Magnus resides in abyssal gloom and lights the way for others until he can feel satisfied with the life he has lived. The first person Magnus offered light to was Tindur, helping her find a good therapist and begin overcoming her trauma. Magnus has since used the power of the Lurking Light to become a superhero for his coastal town, adopting the superhero name "Grim Leader".

Magnus is a gentle and kind man. He is incredibly empathetic and patience, also doing so much for Sand Shine Town's community. Magnus excels an uplifting others and finding the best parts of people to encourage and nurture, yet struggles to value himself in identify the worth he so effortlessly finds in other people. He isn't sure what life holds for him, but never doubts himself as he follows his own "light", believing will one day find his final destination with a smile. Magnus is still depressed and suicidal, but trusts the Lurking Light to fuel the willpower he otherwise has lost many years ago.

Magnus's speech is deep, throaty, and slow. He mumbles and always seems exhausted, despite his attempts to convey that is paying attention to what people say. He stumbles around with a zombie-like posture.

Likes: Ben. Tindur. His community. Darkness.

Dislikes: Greedy corporations like Clairity Incorporated.

This concludes Recollection #8: Magnus Menis/Grim Leader.]
name: Magnus

Because of this Abyssal Beast spends much of his time underwater and even lives/sleeps in a tank.

Abyssal Beast is a crazed lunatic who sometimes appears as a unfeeling king with regal composure, while other times he's lashing out and screaming in fury. Abyssal Beast is prone to anger and destroying things during manic episodes

[Neo Terra City, the primary city of the Neo Terra-verse. My sandbox. I am Omnilia. I am the Spectator. I am the omniverse herself.

The Neo Terra-verse is an absurd, erotic parody of American comic books in a Cyberpunk-ish setting, featuring hypersexualized and seductive women, where villainess often win and corrupt/hypnotize/brainwash heroines into being a seductive villainess in their own right. I quietly observe and influence conflict in Neo Terra for my own amusement. Sometimes I let the good guys win. Sometimes I don't. I am the reason sexy villainesses with hypnotic powers are so weirdly common. No one may know who I really am, but they feel my influence.

Storylines in the Neo Terra-verse can be divided into "Seasons", each with a central antagonist corrupting the rest of the "cast". The main antagonist of Season 1 is Claire Atropos, COO of Clarity Incorporated, transforming people with her Beast Conversion Program. The beginning of Season 1 is 2037, which the ending coming in 2040. But there were an infinite number of ways things can play out, so it's not a strict rule.

This is the season it all begins, with the villainous Clarity Incorporated megacorporation being overwhelmingly in control from the very beginning. In timelines where Clarity is defeated, the story progress to a new era the heroes will have to fight so hard not to lose. The theme of the season is animal-themed superhero trying to take down Claire Incorporated in various ways, corrupted into evil versions of themselves by the Beast Conversion Program, turning them into a human-animal with the genetics of the very animal they were inspired by. The odds are overwhelmingly in the favor of the villains.]
